scientific_problem: The v0.2-v0.5 centered held-out-species null tests E[C_s|B_train] <= 0, but strong species-private spatial transitions can induce a positive geometry-conditioned transfer baseline. Residualizing that baseline can remove genuine shared signal. v0.6 therefore keeps the raw transfer statistic and changes only the inferential null.

base_statistic.name: v03_raw_transfer
base_statistic.training_response: within-species turnover rank orthogonalized against within-species edge-length rank

private_null_family_v0.1.private_orientation: independent isotropic random normal per species in the pooled affine-standardized active coordinate dimensions
private_null_family_v0.1.rationale: The envelope includes no spatial signal, the original qualification amplitudes, stronger finite signal, and a noise-free limiting private transition. It is deliberately broader than the observed mandatory private controls.

oracle_same_configuration.definition: For a mandatory synthetic cell, compare the observed raw transfer statistic to an independent private-null reference with the same amplitude/noise configuration when available. This only diagnoses whether the statistic contains shared/private information when nuisance strength is known.

private_envelope.definition: For each observed raw transfer statistic T, compute the one-sided Monte Carlo p-value separately under every private-null configuration and take p_envelope(T) = max_config p_config(T).
private_envelope.interpretation: A rejection means transfer exceeds every private-transition baseline in the frozen null family; it does not assume E[C_s]=0.

observed_world_seed_rule: reuse exactly the previously frozen Gate-I fixed_geometry_world seeds for each panel/cell/replicate

precision_requirements.selection_rule: The private-envelope inference is a v0.6 development candidate only if it passes both precision gates on BOTH development panels. The oracle test is never selectable.

confirmation_firewall.if_envelope_passes_development: Do not open confirmation yet. First broaden the private-null nuisance family prospectively across boundary width and offset before locking any v0.6 confirmatory method.
confirmation_firewall.if_envelope_fails_development: Select no v0.6 candidate from this null family and preserve the failure.

observability_use: The shared-geometry observability audit is interpretation-only. It may explain low power but cannot relax the power floor, remove a panel, tune this null family after outcomes, or authorize confirmation.
